colors.name: holo-mist
colors.role: page background — a soft holographic white-violet; the room everything floats in. chrome-ink text reads 12.66:1 (AAA) on it

colors.name: holo-sky
colors.role: holographic gradient stop 1 (lavender ice); foil band fill, card sheen. chrome-ink on it: 11.51:1

colors.name: holo-pink
colors.role: holographic gradient stop 2 (pink ice); the warm band of every foil sweep

colors.name: holo-mint
colors.role: holographic gradient stop 3 (mint ice); foil band fill, the cool band. chrome-ink on it: 13.07:1

colors.name: chrome-silver
colors.role: chrome silver — a glossy MID-TONE surface fill, never text (1.40:1 on mist). The chrome shader, button frames, the liquid-metal band

colors.name: chrome-highlight
colors.role: the wet top sheen of chrome — specular band on the shader, highlight text on the dark chrome band (14.09:1 on chrome-ink)

colors.name: chrome-ink
colors.role: deep chrome shadow — THE ink. Body text, headlines, the dark chrome button band. 12.66:1 on holo-mist; light text reads 14.09:1 on it

colors.name: chrome-ink-2
colors.role: secondary text — chrome-ink lifted one step; eyebrows, glosses (7.76:1 on mist)

colors.name: ink-soft
colors.role: tertiary text — captions, hints (4.75:1 on mist, 4.90:1 on mint — AA; AA-large over the deeper foil stops)

colors.name: accent
colors.role: holographic pink accent — a FILL/SURFACE ONLY (1.91:1 on mist, never text). Chrome glow, foil edge, ::selection bg, the foil seam

colors.name: accent-deep
colors.role: deepened pink for accent-colored TEXT where needed — eyebrows at large display scale (3.82:1 on mist = AA-large, documented)

fonts.role: Latin chrome display — wordmark, hero headline, section titles; weights 400/600/800, the 800 fills like poured metal
all Hangul — a chunky Y2K Korean display face; Korean never hits a fallback sans. Falls through Syne in display stacks
the chrome console — spec numerals, shade codes, eyebrow labels, monospaced readouts

texture: No raster imagery anywhere — deliberate. Chrome is the page's thesis: the hero headline is a single WebGL fragment shader painting a horizontally-stacked chrome gradient (silver → highlight → shadow → silver) displaced by layered sine ripples and a pointer gaussian, so the metal reads as a liquid that notices your hand; a flat holographic-gradient scrim sits behind it so no-JS and shader-failure never show a hole. Holographic foil is layered CSS: three offset conic/linear gradient bands (lavender → pink → mint) in mix-blend-mode: screen over a chrome-silver base, their angular origin lerped by the pointer — the rainbow sheen. Every product 'photo' is a CSS chrome pill: a radial chrome gradient with a moving specular and a holographic underglow. Chrome type uses layered text-shadows (white top highlight, dark bottom shadow) to fake the beveled metal edge on a flat fill.

motion.name: ease-chrome
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) — the metallic sweep: fast gather, long bright tail

motion.name: ease-foil
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) — a slight overshoot, the foil settling

motion.name: char-sweep
motion.value: per-glyph 620ms ease-chrome, 55ms observer-batch stagger; each glyph clips inset(0 100% 0 0)→0 then the chrome sweep crosses it

motion.name: chrome-shader-rpm
motion.value: ambient ripple drift ~0.18 rad/s on the slow axis, 0.27 on the fast; pointer raises amplitude via a gaussian lens, lerp 0.09/frame

motion.name: foil-parallax
motion.value: three foil layers shift origin ±18°/±11°/±6° with the pointer, lerped 0.06/frame, capped

motion.name: pointer-lerp
motion.value: 0.09 per 60fps-normalized frame — the chrome slews like a heavy liquid, never snaps

motion.name: idle-ripple
motion.value: after 2400ms pointer silence, or always on touch: a lissajous ripple target (sin 0.00021t / sin 0.00033t+0.7) keeps the metal alive

motion.name: glow-pulse
motion.value: 4.2s, the chrome button's accent halo breathes opacity 0.35↔0.7 + 6px drift
